name: Musicfox Control
author: zach
description: Now-playing bar widget and panel for musicfox (the terminal NetEase Cloud Music player). Reads and drives musicfox over MPRIS, so it needs no fork of the player: artwork, title, transport controls, seeking, volume, lyrics and the current queue.

barWidget.description: Now-playing title with artwork, transport controls, seek, volume, lyrics and the current queue.

schema.label: Bar shows
schema.description: What the bar widget prints next to the play glyph.

schema.label: Max label width
schema.description: Pixel budget for the lyric/title. It is truncated with an ellipsis so a long lyric cannot grow the widget over the bar's center cluster.

schema.label: Scroll lyrics instead of the title
schema.description: When musicfox exposes a timed lyric, show the current line on the bar. Falls back to the title when there is no lyric.
